Is it time already? The air at the valley entrance has changed. That must be %s.
strings.아드키나 님, 제가 지금까지 메시지를 전달하면서 내용을 몰랐던 적이 없었: Lord Atkina, I've never delivered a message without knowing what it said before. This one makes me curious.
strings.내가 프레이오스에는 가본 적이 없지만, 그곳은 신들의 숨결이 남아있는 대: I have never been to Freios, but I know it as a continent where the breath of the gods still lingers.
strings.그런 대륙의 거대한 세력의 제국, 거기에 예언의 능력을 가진 황제. 필시: An empire of great influence on such a continent, and an empress with the gift of prophecy. She must be an extraordinary person.
strings.미르, 네가 %s에게 건네준 칙서. 거기 남겨진 힘의 흔적이 바로 그 증: Mir, the decree you gave %s. The trace of power left upon it is proof... Perhaps...
You felt it too, Lord Atkina.
strings.신의 입을 빌려 말하는 것이 예언이지. 그러니 황제가 가지고 있는 능력은: Prophecy is speaking through a god's mouth. So perhaps the empress's gift means...
She may be a being like us, or like 'them.'
Mir, you must have some idea yourself.
strings.(저 멀리 %s의 모습이 보이자 아드키나가 말을 멈춘다. 미르 또한 알았: (Atkina stops speaking as %s appears in the distance. Mir nods in understanding.)
strings.아드키나님, 제가 늦지는 않았겠죠?: Lord Atkina, I'm not late, am I?
Don't worry. There is still time.
strings.네, 모험가님. 저도 금방 왔어요. 모험가님께서 안의 내용을 확인하시는: Yes, Adventurer. I only just arrived. My task includes seeing you read the contents, so I stayed to watch.
You always work so hard, Mir.
Thank you for saying so. Oh, I think it's time. Please open the decree.
"Dear messenger of the goddess. A wicked group has gathered in the sacred land of Eidos. They intend to interfere with the divine revelation."
Oh! Has something happened in Eidos? Everything was fine recently. Could you read the rest first?
strings.「당신의 신을 위해 방문해주시기 바랍니다. \n\n실바리아 제국 황제 -:
"Please visit for the sake of your god.

Empress of the Silvaria Empire — Kaina Dawn Silvaria..."
strings.이리스를 위해서 언젠가 갈 거라 생각하긴 했어요. 그런데 가기만 하면 되: I thought I'd go there for Iris someday. But is simply going enough...?
strings.얼마 전, 세레스 교단에 가이아 님의 말씀을 전달해드렸거든요. 이면의 형: Recently, I delivered Lady Gaia's message to the Order of Seres. A divine revelation would take place where the reverse side was to appear...
Then a divine revelation will descend upon this place called Eidos.
strings.헛, 그러고 보니 진짜 며칠 안 남았어요. 에이도스면 분명 성기사들도 신: Oh, now that I think about it, there are only a few days left. The paladins in Eidos must know about it. They'll all be trying to receive it.
Paladins who receive a divine revelation become beings no one can rival.
strings.그런데, 실바리아 제국 폐하의 칙서는 어떻게 받아온 거예요?: But how did you receive Her Majesty's decree?
I went to the Temple of Seres on a delivery, and a sister gave it to me.
strings.폐하의 명이라면서 모험가님께 전하라고요. 제가 세레스 신전으로 갈 걸 아: She said Her Majesty ordered me to deliver it to you. Apparently she knew I'd be visiting the temple.
strings.이면이 나타나고, 신탁을 방해하는 존재들이 있다는 건 대체 무슨 일이지…: A reverse side appearing, and beings trying to obstruct a divine revelation... What is happening?
I need to go to Eidos. Thank you, Lord Atkina. Mir.
strings.…별 일 아니길 빌고 싶지만, 분명 보통 일이 아닐 걸세. 부디 조심하게: ...I would like to hope it is nothing serious, but it surely will be. Please take care.
strings.자, 그럼 성역으로 가볼까?: Then, shall I head to the sacred land?
strings.생각해보니까 가는 길을 모르네. 어떻게 가야 하지? 아, 칙서에 추신이: Come to think of it, I don't know the way. How do I get there? Oh, there's a postscript to the decree. Let's see...
Tell the person who wants to rampage to go ahead...? What does that mean?
I can't leave this. I'll go and see her...
strings.(미뉴에트가 멍한 표정으로 서 있다. 평소와 같은 모습인 것처럼 보이지만: (Minuet stands with a vacant expression. She looks much as usual, yet something feels different.)
Minuet, what are you saying? I can't hear anything...
strings.(미뉴에트가 힘겹게 입을 열어 뭔가를 전달하려 하지만, 여전히 목소리는: (Minuet struggles to form words, trying to convey something, but still no sound comes out.)
strings.미뉴에트, 그게 무슨 말이에요? 아니, 어떻게든 제가 가이아 님을 찾아갈: Minuet, what do you mean? No, I'll find Lady Gaia somehow, so...
strings.(미뉴에트가 %s의 두 손을 잡는다. 그러다 생기가 사라진 것처럼 움직임: (Minuet takes both of %s's hands, then stops moving as though all life has left her.)
I feel what I felt when I first came to Adrica.
strings.(어지러워…. 환영의 대지가 기억을 삼키는 것 같아….): (I'm dizzy... It's as though the Land of Illusions is swallowing my memories...)
strings.(%s의 시야에 메디아가 들어온다. 메디아가 가지고 있던 지팡이로 %s의: (Medea comes into %s's view and taps %s on the shoulder with her staff.)
Lady Medea? Oh, that's right! Minuet! Minuet...
Calm yourself. You may fall into confusion again.
strings.당신께서 구해주신 아드리카가 또 다시 이런 상태가 되다니…. 신경쓰지 못: Adrica, which you saved, has fallen into this state again... It is my fault for not paying closer attention.
strings.%s, 여기는 제가 있을 테니 너무 걱정하지 마세요. 어서 당신이 생각하: %s, I will remain here, so do not worry too much. Go where you need to go.
I know what you wish to say. But...
strings.지금 이 일에 관해선 신을 돕겠습니다. 그러면 신을 돕는 자인 당신을 돕: In this matter, I will help the god. That will also mean helping you, who serves the god.
It is my answer to the trust you have shown me...
strings.(물어보고 싶은 것들이 잔뜩이지만, 지금은 상황이 상황이니만큼 나중에 하: (I have so many questions, but with things as they are, they can wait...)
Yes, I understand. Then please take care of Minuet.
strings.(성역에 나타난 이면…. 일단 데이나 씨에게 가서 이야기를 들어보자. 분: (The reverse side appearing in the sacred land... I'll speak to Dayna first. She must know something.)
strings.(메디아가 %s의 기운이 아드리카에서 사라진 걸 확인하고 미뉴에트를 눕힌: (Once Medea confirms that %s's presence has left Adrica, she lays Minuet down.)
Why did you make me the only one able to sense this...?
strings.(데이나가 눈을 감은 채로 뭔가 생각하고 있는 것 같다. 그러다 뭔가 느: (Dayna seems lost in thought with her eyes closed. Suddenly sensing something, she thrusts her staff forward.)
Could you put that staff away? You nearly stabbed me.
Oh, sorry. I thought you were someone else.
strings.(데이나가 지팡이를 거두고 가볍게 미소를 짓는다. 하지만, 그 표정은 갑: (Dayna lowers her staff and smiles faintly, but the smile disappears as her legs suddenly give way.)
strings.부축해줘서 고마워. 좀 쉬면 괜찮아질 거야. 부디 이번엔 좀 길었으면 좋: Thank you for catching me. I'll be fine after some rest. I hope it lasts a little longer this time...
strings.가끔 이러곤 해. 아프기보다는 불편한 것 뿐이야. 힘을 많이 쓴 후에는: This happens sometimes. It's more inconvenient than painful. After using too much power, my legs sometimes give out.
strings.그래도 시이나가 만들어준 이 지팡이가 있어서 다행이야. 그렇지 않으면 제: I'm fortunate to have this staff Shiina made me. Without it, I couldn't even stand properly.
strings.난 살아있어야 해. 그래야 언니도 혼내주고, 시이나도 계속 아껴줄 수 있: I have to stay alive. Then I can scold my older sister and keep cherishing Shiina.
strings.왜 나는 %s 씨만 오면 안 해도 되는 이야기를 계속하게 되는 걸까?: Why do I keep saying things I don't need to whenever you visit, %s?
Sorry. I've gone on too long.
I'm sorry, too. I hope I didn't interrupt your rest.
strings.나는 괜찮아. %s 씨가 온 이유를 알 것 같은데, 성역에 가야 하지?: I'm fine. I think I know why you came, %s. You need to go to the sacred land, don't you?
I heard a reverse side was discovered in Eidos.
That's right. Raclette and Jelic were looking into it, but they had to stop. The person in charge there really hates people like us.
strings.신탁이 내려지는 신성한 곳에 불경한 자들이 온다니 난리겠지. 정말 성기사: They must be furious at the thought of impious people entering a sacred place of divine revelation. Paladins and monks really do judge us however they please.
strings.하여튼 그래서 언니가 %s 씨를 불렀을 거야. 아니면 다른 존재가 이끈: Anyway, that's probably why my sister called for you, %s. Or perhaps another being led you...
strings.주점의 성기사들에게 이야기를 해뒀어. 세라 씨에게 가면 성역 에이도스에: I've spoken to the paladins at the tavern. Sera will tell you how to get to Eidos.
strings.(데이나가 뭔가 말하고 있지만, 소리가 하나도 들려오지 않는다.): (Dayna is saying something, but not a sound can be heard.)
strings.(뭐라고 말하고 있는데, 하나도 들려오지 않아….): (She's speaking, but I can't hear a thing...)
strings.(갑자기 %s의 등 뒤에서 검은 그림자가 파도처럼 크게 일어난다. 그러더: (A black shadow rises like a great wave behind %s, seizes %s, and swallows the adventurer whole.)
Your Highness. It has been a long time. Your greetings remain as violent as ever.
strings.(어둠 한 편에서 낯선 목소리의 주인과 함께 데이나의 모습이 천천히 나타: (Dayna and the owner of the unfamiliar voice slowly appear in a corner of the darkness.)
strings.(데이나 씨? 그리고 저건 누구지? 아니, 나는 방금 데이나 앞에 있었는: (Dayna? And who's that? But I was just standing in front of her... Can she not see me?)
strings.(데이나가 살기를 담아 마족이라 부른 자에게 지팡이를 휘두른다.): (With murderous intent, Dayna swings her staff at the being she calls a demon.)
strings.다른 이들에게서 절 차단한 이 결계가 깨져도 상관없습니까? 상관없으시다면: Do you care if this barrier hiding me from the others breaks? If not...
strings.(데이나가 지팡이를 거두고 마족을 빤히 바라본다.): (Dayna lowers her staff and stares at the demon.)
Hehe. To think a barrier woven by a mere human could be this strong...
I don't want praise from a demon. Speak...
What happened then was regrettable. But it had to be done.
The demon who used my sister as a sacrifice and left me like this...
strings.(데이나가 그제야 마족의 이름을 떠올린 것에 분개한다.): (Dayna seethes at only now recalling the demon's name.)
strings.오, 기억하시는군요. 제 이름을 불러주셔서 영광입니다, 황녀님. 그 일에: Oh, you remember. I am honored to hear you speak my name, Your Highness. I was involved, yes, but only in a small part. At the heart of it was, of course, 'her'...
strings.후후, 저는 잠깐 인사차 온 거니 곧 물러나겠습니다. 그때나 황녀님 자매: Hehe. I merely came to pay my respects, so I will soon leave. I had business with you and your sisters then, but no longer.
You have no business with me? Then could you be after %s...?
strings.심부름꾼 보단 일을 시키는 존재에게 있죠. 전 그에게 그저 무슨 일을 할: More with the one giving orders than with the messenger. I will merely let the messenger know what I intend to do.
strings.(바르바토스의 눈빛이 날카로워지면서 어디선가 꺼낸 거대한 검으로 주위의: (Barbatos's eyes sharpen. Drawing an enormous sword from somewhere, he slices through the surrounding air.)
strings.(그 영향이 데이나에게까지 갔는지, 데이나가 고통스러운 표정을 지으며 주: (The force seems to reach Dayna as well. She collapses with a pained expression.)
strings.황녀님은 이 정도로 무너지시면 안 됩니다. 제가 주인이 될 세계에 초대해: You must not fall so easily, Your Highness. I intend to invite you to the world I will rule. And you must become the vessel of a shattered world.
You, who walk in the shadows between light and darkness, are more than qualified.
The reverse side discovered in Eidos... It was... It was...
strings.(데이나가 말을 마치지도 못한 채 정신을 잃는다. 그리고 바르바토스가 무: (Dayna loses consciousness before she can finish. Barbatos kneels and kisses her fingertips.)
strings.인간의 정신력으로 잘 버티셨습니다, 황녀님. 아무리 위대한 힘을 가졌다: You endured well with a human's strength of will, Your Highness. However great their power, humans remain humans. Fragile beings...
strings.제가 이제 황녀님을 비롯해 모든 인간들의 주인이 되어 드리겠습니다. 약속: I shall now become your master, and the master of all humanity. You have my promise.
Then I shall depart to prepare the stage. Ah, of course.
strings.미안합니다. 제가 잠시 잊고 있었군요. 신에게 사랑받는 모험가님. 황녀님: My apologies. I forgot for a moment. Adventurer beloved by the gods, do not worry too much about Her Highness. She has only fainted.
strings.넌 누구지? 여긴 뭐야?: Who are you? What is this place?
strings.저는 당신을 사랑하는 신을 모두 벨 것입니다. 가이아는 물론이고, 그 소: I will cut down every god who loves you. Gaia, of course, and that girl as well. Iris, was it?
strings.이리스? 이리스를 건들면 가만두지 않겠어!: Iris? If you touch Iris, you'll answer to me!
Haha. That half-formed goddess cannot even perceive this moment. For now, how about this?
You have no choice in the matter anyway. Let me take out a silver coin.
strings.앞과 뒤, 정면과 이면(異面). 그저 상황에 따른 다른 답일 뿐입니다만…: Front and back, the face and the reverse side. Merely different answers according to circumstance... If tails appears, I shall act upon my will at once...
If heads appears, I will give you a chance. The side engraved with demon horns is heads.
strings.(바르바토스가 품에서 꺼낸 은화 하나를 하나를 향해 던진다. 잠시 후,: (Barbatos tosses a silver coin into the air. A moment later, it falls into his palm, waiting to be revealed.)
strings.운이 좋군요. 그럼 몇 번의 기회…. 정확히는 시련을 드리겠습니다. 이: How fortunate. Then I will give you several chances... Trials, to be precise. Overcoming them is the only way to save your gods.
strings.(바르바토스가 쓰러진 데이나를 일으켜 벽에 기댈 수 있게 한다. 그리고: (Barbatos lifts the unconscious Dayna and rests her against the wall. Then he turns and sneers at %s.)
Let us see whether you can complete those trials.
strings.(바르바토스의 말이 끝나자마자 불길한 어둠이 또 다시 찾아온다.): (The moment Barbatos finishes speaking, the ominous darkness returns.)
strings.(어둠은 모험가를 발버둥 치지 못하게 삼키고, 벌어진 틈 어딘가로 흘러들: (The darkness swallows the adventurer, allowing no struggle, and flows into a rift somewhere.)
Well... I didn't lose consciousness... I don't know how to explain...
strings.(데이나에게 방금 전 본 것들을 모두 설명한다.): (The adventurer tells Dayna everything just witnessed.)
strings.기분 나빠…. 대체 왜 나타난 거야?: I feel sick... Why did he come here?
strings.저기, 데이나 씨. 지금 저와 데이나 씨가 바르바토스를 인식하고 인식하지: Dayna, why could I perceive Barbatos just now when you couldn't?
strings.뒤틀린 시공간…, 그걸 이용하고 있어. 나는 그게 아직도 궁금해. 마족이: Distorted spacetime... He's using it. I still wonder how a demon could have such an ability...
It was like that back then, too... Perhaps...
strings.아, 아니다. %s 씨. 성역에 바로 갈 거지? 지금 어디 아프진 않고?: No, never mind. %s, you're going straight to the sacred land, right? You aren't hurt?
No, I'm fine. I'll go right away.
strings.바르바토스가 나타났다면 보통 일이 아닐 거야. 그 마족이 신탁을 방해하는: If Barbatos has appeared, this is serious. Especially if he's the one interfering with the divine revelation.
I wish I could go with you. I'm sorry I can't.
I'll be back. Don't worry too much. I'll go see Sera.
What Barbatos wants in the sacred land may be...
strings.(언제나 사람으로 가득 찼던 길드 여관에 평소와는 다른 적막함이 느껴진다: (The guild inn, usually full of people, is strangely quiet. At the sound of the door opening, Sera approaches with a bright smile.)
The same as always. Helping at the inn and training every day.
strings.선배는 요즘도 바빠서 얼굴 보기 힘들어요. 그 정도 일하면 홀리오더에서: She's still so busy that I hardly see her. With that much work, she should have advanced from Holy Order to Savior ages ago...
Come to think of it, the only paladins from the sacred land I've met are you, Platina, and Aurum.
You'll be able to meet Lady Aurum soon.
I'd like to ask you to stay and rest a little, but I should tell you.
strings.실바리아 제국 황제 폐하의 요청으로 성역 원로들께서 모험가님의 성역 출입: At the Empress of Silvaria's request, the elders have granted you permission to enter the sacred land.
strings.원래는 외부인의 출입이 좀처럼 허용되지 않는 곳인데 특별한 경우라고 할: Outsiders are rarely admitted, so this is a special exception.
strings.그렇군요. 그러면 어디로 가면 될까요?: I see. Where should I go?
Would you close your eyes for a moment?
strings.(눈을 뜨자 낯설면서도 묘한 분위기가 느껴진다.): (When the adventurer opens their eyes, the atmosphere feels unfamiliar and strange.)
strings.(어딘가로 향하는 중간 관문 겸 사무실 같은 공간 중심에 나무 방망이를: (In a room that seems to serve as both a checkpoint and an office, a woman carrying a wooden club slowly approaches.)
I wondered who it was. So it's you, Adventurer. If you'd been an enemy, I would have sent you flying...
strings.기다리고 있었습니다. 성역 에이도스에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 일단 여기 출: I've been waiting. Welcome to Eidos, the sacred land. First, would you sign the entry register? Name, %s...
strings.아, 네. 잠깐, 여기가 성역 에이도스라고요? 그리고 절 기다리고 있었다: Oh, yes. Wait. This is Eidos? And you were waiting for me?
strings.(신탁을 받는 장소와 가이아 님, 그리고 가이아 님을 노리는 바르바토스…: (The place of divine revelation, Lady Gaia, and Barbatos, who is after her...)
strings.(바르바토스가 있는 장소를 찾아야 해.): (I have to find where Barbatos is.)
strings.모험가님? 무슨 생각을 그렇게 하세요?: Adventurer? What are you thinking about so hard?
strings.여기 아우룸 말고는 아무도 없나요?: Is there no one here except you, Aurum?
strings.이곳에 일이 생겨서 수습하러 전부 나갔어요. 마음 같아선 저도 나가고 싶: Something happened, and everyone went out to deal with it. I'd like to go too, but I was ordered to receive you here.
strings.자세한 건 모르지만, 성역에 악마와 마족들이 나타났어요. 그리고 성스러운: I don't know the details, but demons and fiends appeared in the sacred land. Even the sacred beings seem to be affected and are running wild.
strings.맹약의 성소에도 다가갈 수 없을 정도라 모험가님의 행방을 파악하고 있었던: We can't even approach the Sanctum of the Covenant. I understand they were trying to locate you.
Shouldn't you be out there too, Aurum? You're a Savior of the highest skill.
strings.부끄럽지만, 근신 처분을 받았어요…. 그래서 여기서 꼼짝도 못 하고 있습: It's embarrassing, but I've been confined to quarters... So I can't leave this place.
strings.이스트랜드를 알고 싶다는 생각에 돌아다니다 지스카드 님께 붙잡혔고, 폐하: I went wandering because I wanted to learn about Eastland, but Sir Ziskad caught me. Her Majesty told me not to run wild for a while...
strings.(아, 역시 아우룸답다고 해야 하나….): (Ah, that really does sound like Aurum...)
When you say you were ordered, you mean Her Majesty told you.
...Yes. Her Majesty hasn't yet given me permission to rampage...
strings.폐하의 칙서에 날뛰고 싶은 사람에게 날뛰라고 쓰여 있었으니 날뛰어도 될: Her Majesty's decree says to tell the person who wants to rampage to go ahead. So I think you can.
strings.(아우룸에게 카이나 황제의 칙서를 보여준다.): (The adventurer shows Aurum Empress Kaina's decree.)
strings.감사합니다, 폐하. 그러면 성심성의를 다해 적들에게 이스트랜드에서 만난: Thank you, Your Majesty. Then I will give the enemy a taste of something as hot as the Priring curry I found in Eastland, with all my heart.
First, we need to see how many enemies there are...
strings.좋아요! 기다렸던 말이에요. 아, 적들 뿐만 아니라 폭주하고 있는 존재들: Wonderful! That's what I've been waiting to hear. Oh, we'll need to discipline the sacred beings running wild, too. Are you all right with that?
With your weapon and my help, I think we can restore them to normal.
strings.(두 사람이 성역 에이도스의 상황을 살피기 위해 나간다. 잠시 후, 아무: (The two leave to inspect Eidos. A little later, a knight in silver armor and enormous gauntlets appears at the deserted checkpoint.)
strings.그런데 왜 아무도 없지??: But why is no one here?
strings.방금 보신 존재들은 고대 시절 신을 위해 싸우던 발키리들의 성스러운 혼이: Those beings you just saw are the sacred souls of Valkyries who fought for the gods in ancient times. Their bodies died, but their spirits remain here.
strings.숨겨져 있던 한 조각을 어떤 기사가 찾으면서 그들은 성역에서 기사들과 함: After a knight discovered a hidden fragment, they came to dwell alongside the knights in the sacred land.
...And we just gave those Valkyries a beating.
It's fine. Given the situation, I'm sure they'll understand.
But if they don't even recognize me as a Savior, something is definitely wrong.
We'll have to keep fighting them until we find the cause.
strings.(아우룸이 안에서 기다리고 있던 은색 갑옷을 입은 붉은 머리의 기사 보더: (Aurum looks startled at the red-haired knight in silver armor waiting inside.)
Even under imperial orders, please remember your duties as a paladin, Aurum.
You aren't a Holy Order or a Savior.
strings.실바리아 제국 황실 소속의 기사단의 아르젠트라고 합니다. 폐하의 명으로: I am Argent of the Silvaria Empire's imperial knights. Her Majesty has ordered me to accompany you.
strings.일단 오셨으니 여기 출입기록에 서명을 해주시겠어요, 아르젠트?: Since you're here, would you sign the entry register, Argent?
strings.아르젠트는 지금 여기 무슨 일이 일어나는지 알고 있으신가요? 폐하의 명에: Argent, do you know what's happening here? Since Her Majesty sent you, I thought you might...
strings.폐하께서 의회의 요청에 응해달라고 부탁하셨습니다. 성역에 계신 %s 님을: Her Majesty asked me to answer the council's request. She said I should find %s in the sacred land and offer assistance.
strings.의회의 귀족들은 정말 멋대로라…. 아, 아닙니다. 아우룸, 성역의 상황은: The nobles on the council are so self-serving... Ah, never mind. Aurum, what is the situation here?
strings.(이면은 어디서 찾아야 하는 거지? 어?!): (Where should I look for the reverse side? Huh?!)
strings.(갑자기 바닥에서 원인 모를 진동이 일어난다. 순간적으로 아우룸이 발을: (An unexplained tremor suddenly shakes the ground. Aurum loses her footing, and Argent catches her.)
Argent, I'm sorry. That was definitely...
strings.일반적인 지진이 아닌 것 같습니다. 인위적으로 누군가 일으킨 듯한…. 그: It doesn't seem to be an ordinary earthquake. As though someone caused it deliberately... At least it didn't continue...
strings.지금 바로 가봐야겠어요. 성역의 제일 안쪽…. 거기서 느껴졌어요. 진동의: We need to go now. To the deepest part of the sacred land... That's where I felt the tremor coming from.
Understood. Let us depart at once. Aurum, lead the way.
...The situation is more serious than I expected.
It reminds me of the 'Sky of Chaos' I once read about.
strings.수백 년 전, 프레이오스의 패권을 다투던 전쟁입니다. 그 전쟁에서 수많은: A war fought hundreds of years ago for dominance over Freios. Many powers and kingdoms rose and fell in that war.
strings.당시 실바리아 왕국은 패권을 잡아 제국으로 거듭났습니다. 이건 과거의 이: The Kingdom of Silvaria gained supremacy and became an empire. But that is history, and not our concern now.
strings.지금 악마와 마족이 기를 쓰고 신탁을 막으려 하고, 발키리를 비롯한 신성: Demons and fiends are desperately trying to block the divine revelation, while the Valkyries and other sacred beings cannot distinguish their enemies.
And the reason you came here must be connected to all of it.
strings.말씀해주셨으면 합니다. 폐하의 명이긴 하지만, 그래야 저도 납득하고 도울: I would like you to explain. I am here on Her Majesty's orders, but understanding will allow me to help properly.
Now that you mention it, I'm curious too.
Aurum, you looked so happy just fighting enemies that I never had a chance to tell you.
strings.(두 사람 죽이 잘 맞는 것 같네. 원래 알고 있던 사인가….): (These two work well together. Do they know each other already...?)
strings.아, 네…. 아르젠트 님도 데이나 씨를 알고 계시죠?: Oh, yes... Argent, you know Dayna, don't you?
strings.(아르젠트와 아우룸에게 칙서를 받은 후 일어났던 일을 전부 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Argent and Aurum everything that happened after receiving the decree.)
strings.괜찮으실 겁니다. 바르바토스가 집중하는 건 현재 성역…. 먼저 그 자를: She should be. Barbatos is currently focused on the sacred land... We must find and defeat him first. A fiend who threatens a god...
You seem to know Barbatos, Argent.
strings.제가 기사단의 막내였을 때, 그가 나타났었습니다. 황녀님들께서 큰일에 휘: He appeared when I was the youngest member of the order. The princesses were nearly caught in a terrible incident. All of us lost part of our memories of that time...
Something strange must be happening in the Sanctum of the Covenant.
strings.하지만, 모험가님과 아르젠트는 지금 들어갈 수 없어요. '그분'에게 인사: But you and the adventurer can't enter yet. You need to pay your respects to 'her.'
strings.고대 신들이 아끼던 전투 천사, 발키리들의 스승이자 성기사의 친구…. 미: Lady Michaela. A battle angel cherished by the ancient gods, teacher of the Valkyries, and friend to paladins...
Once you've greeted Lady Michaela, you'll be qualified to enter the Sanctum of the Covenant.
You can simply walk in, but sometimes you won't be able to see what you came to see.
strings.…그렇군요. 그런데, 아우룸. 뒤에 빨간 건 뭡니까?: ...I understand. But Aurum, what is that red thing behind you?
What? ...What is that? I've been confined and haven't been outside...
A doorway to somewhere? There are feathers scattered all through it.
Oh! Those are definitely Lady Michaela's...
Then Lady Michaela is in there.
strings.…어떻게 하시겠습니까? 저 안에 보이는 건 분명 성역인데, 성역이 아닌: ...What shall we do? What I see inside is clearly the sacred land, yet seems to be something else...
Then this is the sacred land's reverse side...
strings.(들어가려고 하는 순간, 머리 위에서 바르바토스의 목소리가 들려온다.): (Just as they are about to enter, Barbatos's voice sounds overhead.)
strings.[…별 거 아니지만, 작은 시련 하나를 드리겠습니다.]: [...It is nothing much, but I shall grant you one small trial.]
strings.(갑자기 엄청난 수의 마족들이 나타나 일행을 포위한다. 게다가 문의 붉은: (An enormous number of fiends suddenly appear and surround the group. The doorway's red light begins to darken.)
strings.마족이 보낸 시련이란 게 겨우 이런 거라니 우습군. 제가 일단 여기를 처: So this is all a fiend's trial amounts to? Laughable. I will deal with these and follow you.
Ugh, something like a barrier is blocking me. But why can the adventurer...
strings.바르바토스가 시험해보고 싶은 건 두 사람이 아니라 저라서 그런 것 같아요: I think it's because Barbatos wants to test me, not you two.
strings.알겠습니다. 아우룸과 제가 이놈들을 상대하겠습니다. 모험가님,: Understood. Aurum and I will face these creatures. Adventurer...
...I'm sorry. I'll be back as quickly as I can.
strings.(미카엘라 님을 만나지 못하면 맹약의 성소에 들어가서도 가이아 님을 만날: (If I don't meet Lady Michaela, I won't be able to see Lady Gaia even inside the Sanctum of the Covenant...)
strings.(%s의 모습이 성역을 삼킨 듯한 붉은 공간으로 향하고, 이를 확인한 아: (As %s enters the red space that seems to have swallowed the sacred land, Argent turns quietly toward Aurum.)
Aurum, you may set aside your usual duties for a moment.
Really? To hear that from you, Argent... Well, well...
strings.그러면 제대로 날뛰어볼까요?: Then shall I really let loose?
strings.(붉은 빛과 음울한 기운이 뒤섞여 가득 채워진 어떤 세계, 그 안으로 발: (The instant the adventurer steps into a world filled with red light and gloomy energy, an unknown revulsion takes hold.)
This must be the sacred land, but...
strings.[…이곳은 성역이면서 성역이 아닌 곳입니다. 신들의 과거가 봉인된 무덤과: [...This is the sacred land, and yet it is not. A place like a tomb, where the gods' past is sealed... Hyle...]
strings.(또 다시 바르바토스의 목소리가 붉은 공간 안을 파고들어 %s에게 닿는다: (Once again, Barbatos's voice pierces the red space and reaches %s.)
strings.[…잊었습니까? 이건 제가 당신에게 드리는 시련…. 어디까지 발버둥 칠: [...Have you forgotten? This is the trial I am giving you... I wonder how far you can struggle. I look forward to seeing it.]
It's all just pretty words. I know you're going to do whatever you want anyway.
strings.혹시 바이스와 관련된 일이야?: Does this have something to do with Weiss?
strings.[그러면 대답해드리죠. 목적은 다르지만, 본질은 같다고….]: [Then I shall answer. Our aims differ, but their essence is the same...]
strings.(목소리에 누군가를 향한 불쾌함이 담겨있다. 이어 시련을 주겠다던 마족의: (His voice carries displeasure toward someone. Then the fiend's voice disappears without a trace.)
strings.…바이스의 이야기를 하니까 그대로 사라져버렸어. 기분 나빠하는 것 같던데: ...The moment I mentioned Weiss, he vanished. He sounded upset...
First, I have to find Lady Michaela. Only then can I meet Lady Gaia... All right. Let's go.
strings.(붉은빛이 가득한 세계의 끝, 더 나아갈 곳도 물러날 곳도 없는 그런 공: (At the edge of the crimson world lies a place with nowhere to advance or retreat. A woman in sacred knight's attire hovers ahead on pure white wings.)
strings.(날개가 있는 여성이 자신을 부르는 목소리에 고개를 끄덕인다. 그러더니: (The winged woman nods at the voice calling her name, then flies forward at great speed and swings her sword.)
strings.(후, 겨우 피했다. 빠른 데다 날카로운 공격이야….): (Whew, barely dodged it. Such a fast, precise attack...)
I came looking for you, Lady Michaela...
strings.이 공간에 들어온 건 확인하기 위해서지만, 이렇게 된 건 내 뜻이 아니야: I entered this place to investigate, but I never meant for this to happen.
strings.가이아 님의 손길, 세레스 님의 마음, 그리고 이리스 님의 걱정까지 너에: I can feel Lady Gaia's touch, Lady Seres's heart, and even Lady Iris's concern in you.
If you can feel all that, there's no need to attack me.
The scent of an ominous being led me here. Like a beast...
Yes. A scent. Mika cannot let someone with that scent remain in the sacred land.
W-wait. I'm not your enemy. You don't have to fight me.
Mika knows you're the goddess's person. Mika believes in you.
There must be a misunderstanding. Please think again.
strings.(검을 든 미카엘라가 날갯짓을 하며 %s에게 빠른 속도로 날아온다.): (Sword in hand, Michaela beats her wings and rushes toward %s.)
strings.(겨우 막았지만, 이렇게 버티긴 힘들어….): (I barely blocked it. I can't hold on like this...)
strings.미카의 의지면서 의지가 아닌 이 상황, 날 끊어줘. 날 이렇게 만들 수: This is Mika's will, yet it isn't. Break me free. Only those with great power should be able to do this to me...
strings.네? 자, 잠깐…. 멋대로 움직이는 거야? 자기 의지가 아닌 거야?: What? W-wait... You're moving against your will? You aren't choosing to do this?
Break it. For Lady Gaia's sake, too.
strings.싸우고 싶지 않았는데…. 아!: I didn't want to fight... Ah!
(Maybe my power... can restore Lady Michaela to normal.)
strings.미카엘라, 미카엘라가 정신을 차릴 때까지 버텨요. 그러니 무너지지 마요!: Michaela, hold on until you come back to yourself. Don't give in!
strings.(혼신의 힘을 다한 %s의 공격이 미카엘라에게 닿는다.): (%s pours every ounce of strength into an attack that reaches Michaela.)
strings.(미카엘라가 다리에 힘이 풀렸는지 검을 붙잡고 그대로 주저앉는다.): (Michaela's legs give way. She sinks to the ground, gripping her sword.)
Mika is all right. You broke what was binding me...
Only a being above Mika can control Mika...
strings.네? 그러면 일부러 미카엘라 님을 이렇게 만든 자가 있다는 건가요?: What? Then someone deliberately did this to you?
strings.(미카엘라가 %s의 앞으로 나와 습격해오는 누군가의 공격을 튕겨낸다.): (Michaela steps in front of %s and deflects an assailant's attack.)
strings.(습격에 실패한 누군가가 뒤로 물러난다.): (The attacker retreats after the failed strike.)
strings.이번 시련은 제가 예상했던 것보다 일찍 끝난 것 같습니다. 그러면 잠시: This trial seems to have ended sooner than I expected. Then let us remove a minor nuisance.
strings.대체 미카엘라 님을 어떻게 한 거야?: What did you do to her?
strings.사실 저도 모르겠습니다. 그저 조용했으면 좋겠다고 생각했던 것 뿐. 제: To be honest, I don't know either. I merely wished she would be quiet. That angel is not my concern...
strings.하여튼, 당신의 신들이 아끼던 천사를 살리고 싶다면 바로 데리고 나가시길: In any case, if you want to save the angel your gods cherished, take her out of here immediately. Otherwise...
The ominous energy of this place will devour her.
strings.(바르바토스가 조소를 담아 %s를 바라보며 등을 돌린다.): (Barbatos turns away, giving %s a mocking look.)
strings.어차피 이 공간에서 당신이 전투천사의 도움 없이 나를 공격하는 건 불가능: You cannot attack me in this space without the battle angel's help. Rather than entertain foolish thoughts, take even one step closer to the exit.
strings.다른 마족 놈들이 노리기 전에…. 저는 가보겠습니다. 다음 무대에서 기다: Before the other fiends come for you... I shall leave. I'll await you on the next stage.
strings.마계에 무슨 일이 있는 거지? 너는 바이스를 알고 있어. 바이스가 했던: What's happening in the Demon Realm? You know Weiss. Everything he's done has been connected to demonic energy.
Did I not tell you? Our aims differ, but their essence is the same.
strings.자, 이대로 계속 계시겠습니까?: Now, will you continue to stand here?
Until then... Next, follow the angel's wishes.
strings.(어디선가 나타난 검은 나비가 바르바토스 곁을 맴돌더니 함께 사라져 버린: (A black butterfly appears from somewhere, circles Barbatos, and vanishes with him.)
I think I hit a nerve.
...But that doesn't make him an easy opponent. Up we go.
strings.(미카엘라를 일으켜 부축하지만, 여전히 깨어날 기미가 보이지 않는다.): (The adventurer lifts and supports Michaela, but she shows no sign of waking.)
Lady Michaela, hold on a little longer. I think we just need to get outside somehow...
Her Majesty's intentions remain beyond me...
strings.아, 밖이다. 드디어 나왔어,: Oh, outside! I finally made it!
strings.(아르젠트가 등 뒤에서 들려오는 %s의 목소리에 놀라 다가온다.): (Startled by %s's voice behind him, Argent hurries over.)
Yes, I'm fine, but Lady Michaela...
So this is Michaela, the battle angel... How beautiful.
strings.%s 님, 저 붉은 공간 안에서 무슨 일이 있었던 겁니까?: %s, what happened inside that red space?
strings.(아르젠트가 미카엘라를 바라보다가 말을 이어가지 못한다.): (Argent looks at Michaela and falls silent.)
strings.아우룸은 다른 기사들과 성역 안을 돌아다니는 마족과 악마들을 쓰러뜨리고,: Aurum and the other knights defeated the fiends and demons roaming the sacred land. She's resting at the checkpoint.
I remained here to wait for you, %s.
strings.미안해요. 빨리 나오고 싶었는데, 좀 늦었네요. 지금 시간이 얼마나 지난: I'm sorry. I wanted to return quickly, but I took longer than expected. How much time has passed?
strings.저희도 들어가고 싶었지만, 여전히 막혀있었습니다. 허락되는 인물만 들어갈: We wanted to enter as well, but the way remained barred. A space only permitted people may enter...
strings.(그때와 같아…. 마법학원 본관에서 밖으로 나왔을 때 시간이 많이 흘렀었: (Just like before... So much time had passed when I left the academy's main building.)
Anyway, the next stage Barbatos mentioned... I think I know where it is.
strings.혹시 몰라 맹약의 성소에 다녀왔지만, 큰 문제는 없었습니다. 하지만, 아: I checked the Sanctum of the Covenant, but found no major problem. Yet as Aurum said, to see what is truly there...
strings.제대로 인사하지 않으면 그 안의 상황을 알 수 없을 것 같아요. 일단 아: Unless I greet her properly, I don't think I can understand what's happening inside. Aurum is at the checkpoint. Let's ask her what we can do.
%s, let me support Lady Michaela. You must be exhausted from battle...
strings.(아르젠트가 손을 뻗어 미카엘라를 부축하려고 하지만, 닿지 않는다. 마치: (Argent reaches to support Michaela, but cannot touch her. His hands pass through as though she were an illusion.)
%s, you are an adventurer of the gods. That is why you were able to bring her out.
strings.…제가 미카엘라 님을 부축하고 갈게요. 아르젠트, 혹시 모르니 관문까지: ...I'll carry on supporting her. Argent, please escort us to the checkpoint, just in case.
strings.(성역의 입구나 다름없는 관문으로 돌아오자마자 아우룸이 깜짝 놀라 달려온: (As soon as they return to the checkpoint at the entrance to the sacred land, Aurum rushes over in alarm.)
%s, are you all right? W-wait. How did Lady Michaela get here...?
Yes. First, lay Lady Michaela here...
strings.(미카엘라를 침대 위에 눕히자 어디선가 알 수 없는 빛이 다가온다.): (As they lay Michaela on the bed, an unfamiliar light approaches from somewhere.)
I should explain to you too, Aurum. What happened was...
strings.(아우룸에게 붉은 공간에 있었던 일들을 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Aurum about the events in the red space.)
strings.…이럴 수가…. 그러면 미카엘라 님을 어떻게 깨우죠?! 미카엘라 님이 없: ...How could this happen...? Then how do we wake Lady Michaela?! Without her, the sacred land will... Mmph... mmph?
Aurum, you're noisy. Mika is all...
strings.(미카엘라가 힘겨운 표정으로 자리에서 일어난다. 그리고 손을 뻗어 아우룸: (Michaela struggles to sit up, then reaches out and covers Aurum's mouth.)
strings.미카엘라 님, 괜찮으신가요?: Lady Michaela, are you all right?
Mika is all right. No, not all right. It feels strange.
Nothing like this has ever happened to Mika. That fiend...
%s, thank you for helping me. But it isn't over.
Please let me enter the Sanctum of the Covenant. I have to see Lady Gaia.
strings.아, 가이아 님…. 가이아 님을 지켜야 해. 하지만, 지금 미카는 가이아: Ah, Lady Gaia... We must protect her. But Mika cannot see Lady Gaia right now.
She has ordered Mika to rest for a while...
strings.(미카엘라가 %s의 얼굴에 다가가 볼 키스를 한다.): (Michaela leans toward %s and kisses the adventurer on the cheek.)
In some regions, people do greet one another that way...
Yes. That's how Lady Michaela greets people.
strings.미카엘라 님, 이제 성소에 들어갈 수 있는 거죠?: Lady Michaela, I can enter the sanctum now, right?
strings.이제 %s…, 맹약의 성소에 들어갈 수 있을 거야. 하지만, 조심해야 해: Now you can enter the Sanctum of the Covenant, %s. But be careful. He is waiting.
strings.그는 보통 마족이 아니야. %s, 네가 그동안 상대했던 자들보다 더 위험: He is no ordinary fiend. %s, he is more dangerous than those you've faced before...
strings.(갑자기 바닥에서 원인 모를 진동이 일어난다.): (Another unexplained tremor suddenly shakes the ground.)
strings.바보토스가 이끄는 마족과 악마들이 다시 나타났어. 그가 가진 힘…, 확인: The fiends and demons Dummytos commands have appeared again. His power... I need to investigate it. But Mika must rest now, as Lady Gaia wishes.
Go and meet him, as he wants.
I will. I have to see Lady Gaia...
Mika is asking you. And Mika is sorry...
strings.(말을 끝낸 미카엘라가 그대로 정신을 잃고 침대 위로 쓰러진다.): (As she finishes speaking, Michaela loses consciousness and falls back onto the bed.)
I'll go straight to the Sanctum of the Covenant. So...
Don't worry. I'll watch over Lady Michaela.
strings.아우룸, 날뛰고 싶을 텐데 괜찮습니까?: Aurum, are you sure? You must want to run wild.
It's fine. Opportunities to watch over Lady Michaela don't come often, either.
strings.(말과는 달리 아우룸의 표정이 많이 아쉬워 보인다.): (Despite her words, Aurum looks deeply disappointed.)
strings.그러면 빨리 바르바토스와의 일을 해결하고 돌아오겠습니다. 그때까지 버텨주: Then I'll settle things with Barbatos and return as quickly as I can. Hold on until then...
%s, come with me. I will escort you to the sanctum's entrance.
strings.(아르젠트가 발밑에 쓰러진 마족의 상태를 살펴본다.): (Argent examines the fiend lying at his feet.)
They are definitely stronger than the creatures that came here a few days ago.
strings.(그런 거 치고 아르젠트는 적을 너무 쉽게 처치하는 것 같은데….): (For all that, Argent seems to defeat them awfully easily...)
strings.%s 님, 저 붉은 공간으로 가는 통로가 아직 남아있군요. 미카엘라 님과: %s, the passage to that red space is still there. The atmosphere has changed considerably since you came out with Lady Michaela.
strings.(성역의 이면인 붉은 장소, 바르바토스가 말한 힐레로 향하는 문이 아직도: (The gateway to the red reverse side of the sacred land, which Barbatos called Hyle, remains open.)
strings.(지금 맹약의 성소에선 온갖 기운들이 느껴져. 이건….): (I can feel all kinds of energy from the Sanctum of the Covenant. This is...)
Argent, you have something to say.
If it isn't urgent, let's talk when I return.
strings.네, 그렇게 하시죠. 헛, 또 적들이…. 모험가님! 어서 서두르세요!: Yes, let's. Ah, more enemies... Adventurer! Hurry!
strings.(말이 끝나자마자 아르젠트가 앞에 나타난 적을 쓰러뜨리기 시작한다.): (Argent immediately begins defeating the enemies before them.)
strings.(…또 무슨 일이 일어날지는 모르겠지만, 빨리 가자. 가서 이 순간을 끝: (...I don't know what will happen next, but I need to hurry. I have to get there and end this.)
strings.(성스럽고 밝은 빛이 가득한 공간의 제단, 어둠 속에서 나온 바르바토스: (In a space filled with sacred, radiant light, Barbatos emerges from the darkness and slowly examines the altar.)
What a strange feeling, to call this contradictory place my stage.
Ah, at last, the protagonist you chose has reached the stage. Goddess Gaia.
Even now, you struggle to stay awake. You have not changed since those days.
The sanctum was more complicated than I expected.
strings.미카엘라가 당신을 여신과 만날 수 있도록 인도한 것 같습니다. 일단, 이: It seems Michaela guided you so that you may meet the goddess. First, there is something I wish to discuss.
strings.당신은 얼마나 알고 있습니까? 이 세계의 진실에 어디까지 닿았습니까?: How much do you know? How far have you reached into this world's truth?
strings.이 세계는 끊임없이 사라져야 하는 파멸의 운명을 안고 태어났습니다. 당신: This world was born bearing a fate of destruction, doomed to vanish again and again. Even the threats you know are numerous.
strings.모든 악의 원흉이라 생각했던 존재, 아가슈라, 창조의 의지를 잘못 이해한: The beings you thought the source of all evil, the Agasuras; the serpent that misunderstood the will of creation; Lux, ruler of the Demon Realm; and Deimos, who will bring terror.
And the frail girl who rose from human to god.
strings.믿고 싶은 대로 믿어도 좋습니다. 그래도 이 세계의 운명은 바뀌지 않습니: Believe whatever you wish. It will not change this world's fate.
Every world with a weak god has accepted its doom and vanished.
strings.그러고 보니 어떤 죄인은 자신의 세계를 파멸의 운명에서 벗어나게 하려고: Come to think of it, a certain sinner seems intent on using this world to free his own from a fate of destruction...
Ah, but that is not my story. Enough of that. Let me tell you my purpose.
strings.세계를 이루는 신은 무릇 그만큼의 힘이 있어야 합니다. 그래야 경외할 수: A god who sustains a world must possess power worthy of that role. Only then can it inspire awe.
strings.하지만, 이 세계는 어떻습니까? 그럴만한 신이 없습니다. 그래서 제가 될: But what of this world? It has no such god. So I will become one.
strings.일단 당신이 알고 있는 두 여신부터 이 세계와 엮인 운명에서 해방시켜드리: First, I shall free the two goddesses you know from the fate that binds them to this world.
Hehe. We merely see things differently.
strings.내가 아는 이 세계의 신은 네가 말한 대로 약할지 몰라. 그래도 큰 위기: The gods I know in this world may be weak, as you say. But they saved everyone from a terrible crisis. And they'll keep saving them.
strings.당신은 두렵지 않습니까? 당신보다 위에 있는 존재가 이렇게 앞에 있는데…: Are you not afraid? A being above you stands before you... A being who controlled even a god's angel.
...I'd be lying if I said I wasn't afraid. But I came all this way for Iris.
I like that look in your eyes, %s...
I think I understand why the sinner Weiss wanted you as a key.
strings.(열쇠? 자, 잠깐…. 뭐, 뭐지? 바르바토스의 분위기가 바뀌었어…. ): (A key? W-wait... What is this? Barbatos's presence has changed...)
strings.(바르바토스가 안경을 고쳐 쓰며 미소를 짓자 주위의 공기가 달라진다. 성: (Barbatos adjusts his glasses and smiles. The air changes, and the sanctum's sacred presence gradually fades.)
strings.(바르바토스가 시공간이 왜곡된 것 같은 틈으로 손을 집어넣는다. 잠시 후: (Barbatos reaches into what looks like a distortion in spacetime. A moment later, the weapon in his hand points at %s's face.)
strings.(바르바토스의 공격이 커다란 충격과 함께 다가와 %s의 자세를 무너뜨린다: (Barbatos's attack strikes with tremendous force, breaking %s's stance.)
strings.(…레테와 비슷할 줄 알았는데…. 지금까지 상대했던 적들과는 달라….): (...I thought he'd be like Lethe... He's different from every enemy I've faced before...)
strings.후우, 끈질기군요. 아직도 버틸 힘이 남아 있습니까?: Whew. Persistent, aren't you? Do you still have the strength to stand?
I am impressed. I underestimated you.
strings.말할 힘이 남아있나 봅니다. 이 정도면 믿음 같은 게 산산조각나야 마땅할: You still have the strength to speak. By now, that faith of yours should be shattered...
strings.당신은 정말 제가 지금까지 만난 존재 중에 제일 기분 나쁘군요. 저와 같: You are truly the most unpleasant being I have ever met. Something alien, like myself...
...An alien being? What do you mean?
A being shaped by someone else's will, without ever wanting it.
But in return for filling my stage so well, I shall tell you something.
strings.(바르바토스가 무기를 거두고 뒤로 물러나자 이상한 기운이 %s에게로 흘러: (Barbatos puts away his weapon and steps back. A strange energy flows toward %s.)
strings.죄인의 속박 같은 거라 착각하지 마셨으면 합니다. 그저 이대로, 그저 이: Please do not mistake this for the sinner's binding. Simply remain as you are and listen.
strings.황혼 어딘가 그 사이에 나도 있었다. 그들의 추악함은 그들이 만든 생명보: I, too, was there, somewhere amid the twilight. Their ugliness surpassed even that of the lives they had created.
strings.이 세계에 다가온 건 거대한 악몽이었다. 그 힘을 느낀 자들은 저항보다: What approached this world was an enormous nightmare. Those who felt its power chose flight over resistance. They were gods.
strings.그런 도망자들의 힘이라도 있어야 가망이 있었다. 그래서 저항하던 이들은: Without even those cowards' power, there was no hope. So those who resisted tried to hold back those who fled.
strings.하지만, 도망자들은 자신을 방해하던 자들을 소멸시키거나 다른 곳으로 추방: But the fleeing gods destroyed those who hindered them, or banished them elsewhere. So they could never return to the world they loved...
strings.(바르바토스가 안경을 고쳐 쓰고는 피식 웃는다.): (Barbatos adjusts his glasses and gives a faint laugh.)
strings.그것이 제가 떠올린 기억. 나머진 당신이 아는 대로 어린 신이 남아 싸웠: Those are the memories I recovered. You know the rest: the young gods remained and fought, only to meet a miserable end...
And after all that, this is what you choose to do...
When my memories returned, only a few gods remained, hiding away.
strings.복수하고 싶었는데, 복수할 대상이 모두 사라지다니…. 그래서 이렇게 된: I wanted revenge, but every target of that revenge was gone... So I became this. If the world is doomed whoever possesses it...
A world with only weak gods left... So they sought something to take their place...
strings.(갑자기 바르바토스가 고통스러운 표정으로 주저앉는다.): (Barbatos suddenly collapses with a pained expression.)
strings.가이아 님…? 어디 계시죠? 괜찮으신가요?: Lady Gaia...? Where are you? Are you all right?
strings.크큭, 가이아 여신이시여. 이제 깨어났습니까? 당신의 힘이 지금 닿을 리: Hehehe. Goddess Gaia. Have you awakened? Your power should not be able to reach this moment...
Urgh... Has that much time already passed?
Ahaha. Lost in sentiment, I failed to keep track of time...
I shall. I will withdraw for today. But I will keep watching. Both Goddess Gaia and %s...
To see how the will that guided you changes...
strings.바르바토스가 사라졌어…. 가이아 님은 괜찮으신 건가? 성역에 있던 불길한: Barbatos has disappeared... Is Lady Gaia all right? All the ominous energy in the sacred land is gone, too.
strings.이건…? 은화…. 바르바토스의 것인가?: What's this...? A silver coin... Barbatos's?
strings.악마의 뿔이 그려져 있다고 한 것 같은데. 이건 나비…? 게다가 앞면과: I thought he said it showed demon horns. But this is a butterfly...? And both sides are the same.
I was tricked. But I don't think everything Barbatos said was a lie...
strings.가이아 님 들리세요? 어디 계세요?: Lady Gaia, can you hear me? Where are you?
...I can definitely feel her, but how do I reach her? I'll go outside first and find out...
Just like that time. The fiends and demons vanished when the black butterflies appeared...
strings.(아르젠트가 고개를 돌려 맹약의 성소 방향을 바라본다.): (Argent turns to look toward the Sanctum of the Covenant.)
strings.저는 괜찮습니다. 그런 모험가님은 괜찮으십니까?: I am fine. Are you all right, Adventurer?
strings.(아르젠트에게 안에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (The adventurer tells Argent what happened inside.)
So you were unable to meet Lady Gaia. Then there may be a way.
Her Majesty left a message. She said to use the obstructer's symbol...
I will explain if an opportunity arises later.
strings.실바리아 제국은 정말 비밀이 많군요. 제가 알 수 없던 일들이 있었던 건: The Silvaria Empire has so many secrets. I can understand that things happened I couldn't know about, but why is there so much no one can tell me?
strings.폐하는 대체 어떤 분이시죠?: What kind of person is Her Majesty, really?
The sovereign of the Silvaria Empire. Respected and benevolent...
strings.…무슨 말씀을 하실지 압니다. 하지만 제가 드릴 말씀은 그 외에 따로 없: ...I know what you wish to say. But I have nothing else I can tell you. I merely...
My apologies. When the time comes, I will bring you before Her Majesty.
strings.(언젠가 만나 묻고 말겠어. 당신은 대체 누구냐고…. 카이나 황제.): (Someday I'll meet her and ask. Who are you, really... Empress Kaina?)
Argent, please finish what you were going to say.
strings.눈을 감은 채로 손에 쥐고 가슴에 닿게 두라고 하셨습니다. 그러면 원하는: She said to close your eyes, hold it in your hand, and press it to your chest. Then you will reach the place you seek...
strings.(방해자의 상징이란 건 바르바토스가 남긴 이 은화겠지?): (The obstructer's symbol must be this silver coin Barbatos left behind.)
strings.(순간 %s의 손안에 있던 바르바토스의 은화가 빛을 받아 반짝거린다.): (The silver coin in %s's hand suddenly catches the light and glitters.)
strings.(헛, 갑자기 신성한 기운이 느껴지는데….): (Oh! I can suddenly feel a sacred energy...)
strings.(눈을 감고 은화를 가슴에 대보자….): (Close my eyes and hold the coin to my chest...)
strings.(아르젠트가 뒤로 물러나 자신이 전한대로 움직이는 %s의 모습을 지켜본다: (Argent steps back and watches %s follow the instructions.)
strings.(순간, 아르젠트의 시야에 믿어지지 않는 광경이 펼쳐진다.): (Suddenly, an unbelievable sight unfolds before Argent.)
strings.(어디선가 신비한 빛을 품은 나비 몇 마리가 날아와 %s의 곁을 스쳐 지: (Several butterflies bearing a mysterious light appear and brush past %s. Then %s vanishes with them, as though carried away on their wings.)
(Is this the Sanctum of the Covenant? No, it's different. The sanctum, yet not the sanctum... Is this another reverse side? No. I'm sure this is my first time here...)
strings.(내가 온 적이 있었나? 바르바토스를 만나러 들어간 곳이 맞나?): (Have I been here before? Is this where I entered to meet Barbatos?)
strings.(맹약의 성소로 보이지만, 다른 느낌이 드는 장소. 따뜻한 미소와 함께: (The place resembles the Sanctum of the Covenant, yet feels different. Gaia waits there, welcoming her visitor with a warm smile.)
strings.다행이에요. 이 시간에서 만날 수 있는 이가 당신이어서…. 그리고 많이: I'm glad. Glad that you are the one I can meet at this time... And that you aren't badly hurt...
strings.아, 이게 아니지? 가이아 님, 괜찮으신가요?: Oh, that isn't what matters. Lady Gaia, are you all right?
strings.가이아 님, 묻고 싶은 게 많아요. 하지만, 가이아 님께서 더 하시고 싶: Lady Gaia, I have so many questions. But I'm sure you have more you wish to say, so I'll wait.
strings.눈을 떠 빛을 찾아 떠난 시간 속에 당도한 장소, 그곳에 대지를 만들어: A little butterfly who opened her eyes and journeyed through time in search of light, reaching a place where she made the earth, so the seeds of life and song could take root.
O world loved by beings such as myself.
Gaia, goddess of the earth, asks you to draw near.
strings.세레스의 뜻을 품고 운명의 아이를 지키는 자, 저와 함께 이곳에 있는 모: You who bear Seres's will and protect the child of destiny, protect the adventurer here beside me. Grant your blessing...
strings.(세레스 님을 만날 때와 같아….): (It's like when I met Lady Seres...)
strings.(가이아가 환한 미소로 눈을 맞춘다.): (Gaia meets the adventurer's eyes with a bright smile.)
strings.(몸이 가벼워진 느낌이긴 하지만, 크게 달라진 건 없는 것 같은데….): (My body feels lighter, but otherwise, nothing seems to have changed much...)
strings.제가 깨어있는 시간에 이 세계를 위해 힘쓰는 이를 위해서 축복을 드리고: While I am awake, I wished to bless someone striving for this world.
strings.세레스가 남긴 달과 별의 시간에 맞춰 이곳에 올 수 있는 이가 바로 적임: The one able to reach this place at the hour of the moon and stars Seres left behind is the right person...
strings.이번엔 누가 될지 몰랐는데, %s…. 이리스가 아끼는 사람이 와서 다행이: I didn't know who it would be this time, but %s... I'm glad it was someone Iris cherishes.
Thank you for saving me and blessing me, Lady Gaia.
strings.아니에요. 제가 더 고마워요. 이제 %s 차례에요. 묻고 싶은 걸 말씀하: No. I am the more grateful one. Now it is your turn, %s. Ask what you wish.
strings.바르바토스에 대해 이야기해주세요. 어째서 그가 가이아 님께 손대려 한 건: Please tell me about Barbatos. Why did he try to harm you?
strings.우주의 섭리에 따라 그 시간에 이곳에 오시는 분께 축복을 드리려고 했어요: In accordance with the order of the universe, I intended to bless whoever came here at that time.
So Barbatos could have been the one who reached this place.
strings.가이아 님도 그를 알고 계셨나요?: Did you know him before, Lady Gaia?
strings.그 이름이 아니기에 잊고 있었어요. 그 또한 레테처럼 그를 두려워하던 이: He did not have that name, so I had forgotten. Like Lethe, he was sent elsewhere by those who feared him. He fell into the Demon Realm...
There, it seems he forgot his name and memories and became a fiend.
I'm sorry. I know nothing of the times when I am asleep...
It's all right, Lady Gaia. Oh, and...
...There is something else you wish to ask.
strings.실바리아 제국 황제에 대해 아시나요?: Do you know about the Empress of Silvaria?
strings.미안해요. 그 부분에 대해서도 아는 바가 없어요. 제가 잠들어 있을 때의: I'm sorry. I know nothing of that either. Events while I was asleep...
strings.그래도 말씀드릴 수 있는 건 있어요. 당신이 아끼는 이리스를 이제 만날: But there is something I can tell you. You will now be able to meet Iris, whom you cherish...
strings.당신의 믿음으로 이리스가 이제 성계신의 자격으로 당신과 이 땅의 생명을: Through your faith, Iris will now be able to watch over you and the lives of this land as the God of the Astral Realm.
But more and more forces will threaten her authority in the days ahead. Please remain by her side and protect her.
strings.이리스를 만나려면 조금만 기다려주세요. 길지 않은 기다림만 지나면 이리스: Wait just a little longer to meet her. After a short wait, Iris will call you herself and speak with you...
%s, I will tell you more the next time we meet.
I still have things to say, but all right.
How do I get back? Ah...
strings.(가이아 님의 모습이 흐릿해져…. 눈앞에 보이는 이건….): (Lady Gaia is fading... What's that in front of me?)
Mika can feel it... Right in front of us...
strings.(미카엘라의 말과 함께 어디선가 따뜻한 바람이 불어온다. 신비한 빛을 품: (As Michaela speaks, a warm breeze arrives. A butterfly bearing a mysterious light follows it, and where it alights, the adventurer slowly appears.)
Well done, %s. Rest beside Mika for a while.
strings.(미카엘라가 정신을 잃은 채 쓰러지려는 %s에게 다가간다. 그리고 자신의: (Michaela approaches %s, who is about to collapse unconscious, and lets the adventurer rest against her shoulder.)
It's because the tension has eased. Mika will help a little.
strings.(미카엘라의 등 뒤에 있던 하얀 천사의 날개가 %s의 몸을 감싼다.): (The white angel wings on Michaela's back fold around %s.)
Oh! Lady Michaela, could you wrap me in your wings too...?
Oh, yes. I, Aurum, will uphold my duties as a paladin. Aww...
Oh, this is... Right. I came back.
strings.그런데 아우룸하고 이쪽으로 온 거예요?: Did you come here with Aurum?
strings.악마와 마족들이 사라지면서 미카엘라 님이 깨어나셨어요. 그래서 여기서 기: Lady Michaela awoke when the demons and fiends disappeared. We've been waiting here.
strings.괜찮으셔서 다행입니다. 여신님을 만나보셨습니까?: I am glad you're all right. Did you meet the goddess?
strings.(더 묻지 않는 건가? 어차피 아르젠트가 듣지 않아도 폐하께서 알고 계시: (He isn't asking any more? Her Majesty will know anyway, even if Argent doesn't hear it.)
Thank you for saving the goddess.
Mika was weak. Mika couldn't save her properly.
No. Mika... I mean, Lady Michaela, you're strong.
Lady Gaia told me. She was happy that you received the divine revelation, %s.
So you received it, %s. If the goddess said that, it truly is a blessing.
Mika will go inside the red gate.
strings.미카엘라 님. 바르바토스가 물러났는데, 다시 들어갈 이유가 있으십니까?: Lady Michaela. Barbatos has withdrawn. Is there a reason to go back inside?
strings.그 안도 성역의 일부야. 그 장소가 발견된 이유를 인식해야 해. 안 그러: That place is part of the sacred land, too. I must understand why it was discovered. Otherwise, Mika will misunderstand again.
If that is your wish, Lady Michaela...
We can't let another being like Dummytos reach the sacred land or the goddesses.
strings.%s. 나중에라도 궁금한 게 있으면 날 찾아와. 붉은 문 안에서 기다리고: %s. If you have questions later, come find me. I'll be waiting inside the red gate.
Aurum and Argent... Thank you. Meet Mika again someday. And %s...
strings.(미카엘라 님이 하고 싶은 말이 있는 거 같은데….): (It seems Lady Michaela has something she wants to say...)
strings.(인사를 마친 미카엘라가 힘찬 날갯짓으로 붉은 문으로 향한다.): (With her farewells said, Michaela beats her wings powerfully and flies toward the red gate.)
strings.(…그러고 보니 그 냄새는 무엇을 의미하는 거지?): (...Come to think of it, what did she mean by that scent?)
strings.이곳의 일은 다 끝난 거겠지. 바르바토스가 언제 다시 나타날지는 알 수: Everything here should be finished. Though I don't know when Barbatos will appear again...
strings.(불안해…. 왜 점점 갈수록 끝이 나질 않는 거지?): (I'm uneasy... Why does it feel as though this will never end?)
strings.이곳의 일이 다 끝난 것 같은데, 아르젠트하고 아우룸은 어떻게 할 건가요: It seems everything here is finished. What will you do now, Argent and Aurum?
I think I need to finish cleaning things up.
strings.성역의 원로들을 찾아뵙고 돌아갈 예정입니다. 원로들께서 언제 오실지는 모: I plan to visit the elders before returning. Though I don't know when they will arrive...
strings.그렇군요. 모두 감사했어요. 저는 돌아갈게요…. 아, 아르젠트. 저는 데: I see. Thank you both for everything. I'll head back... Oh, Argent. I'm going to see Dayna. Is there anything you'd like me to tell her?
strings.황녀님께는 '기다렸다' 라고만 전해주시면 합니다. 그렇게만 말씀드리면 됩: Please tell Her Highness only this: 'I waited.' That is all you need to say...
strings.나중에 또 만나요. 모험가님, 같이 날뛸 일이 생겼으면 좋겠어요!: See you again, Adventurer. I hope we get another chance to run wild together!
strings.데이나 씨, 별일 없었죠?: Dayna, has everything been all right?
Thank you. Thanks to you, nothing happened.
strings.%s 씨가 온 걸 보면 신탁은, 성역의 일은 다 끝난 거지?: Since you're back, %s, the divine revelation and everything in the sacred land are finished, right?
Yes... Things didn't go according to Barbatos's plan. What happened was...
strings.(데이나에게 성역에서의 일을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (The adventurer briefly tells Dayna about the events in the sacred land.)
strings.…그렇게 됐구나. 미안해. 내가 %s의 짐을 덜어줘야 했는데…. 약속할게: ...So that's what happened. I'm sorry. I should have helped ease your burden, %s... I promise. At least this won't happen again next time.
It's all right. I was only doing what I needed to do.
strings.(아르젠트가 그곳에 있다니 의외야….): (I didn't expect Argent to be there...)
strings.데이나 씨, 아르젠트가 데이나 씨를 알고 있어서 제가 전할 말이 있으면: Dayna, since Argent knew you, I asked if he had a message. This is what he said.
He said you'd understand if I told you, 'I waited.'
strings.그랬구나. 소년이었던 기사는 청년이 돼서도 그때의 일이 아직도 마음에 걸: I see. The knight who was once a boy has grown into a young man, yet what happened then must still weigh on him.
strings.실바리아 제국 일이거든. 이게 어디까지 어떻게 이어질지 모르겠지만, 나는: It's a matter of the Silvaria Empire. I don't know how far it will reach or what it will lead to, but I wish you didn't have to know, %s.
...You're too good a person for that... That's why I'm sorry.
strings.저는 괜찮아요. 데이나 씨, 그러면 저 가볼게요. 나중에 또 올게요. 그: I'm all right, Dayna. I'll be going now, but I'll visit again. So don't feel so sorry.
strings.(아드리카 중심부, 파란 머리의 소녀가 누군가를 기다리듯이 배회하고 있다: (At the center of Adrica, a blue-haired girl wanders as if waiting for someone. She spots the approaching adventurer and stops.)
As you can see, I'm fine. Lady Medea helped me.
Lady Gaia is all right, so I am too...
It was nothing. I only did what I had to...
strings.가이아 님께서 말씀하셨던 것처럼 이제 이리스 님을 만나실 수 있어요. 때: As Lady Gaia said, you can meet Lady Iris now. She will call for you when the time comes.
Please hold your feelings for Lady Iris close to your heart.
strings.(어, 왜 가이아 님의 목소리가 들리는 것 같지? 가이아 님의 현신이 미: (Huh? Why did that sound like Lady Gaia's voice? Did I imagine it because Minuet is her incarnation?)
strings.아, 미뉴에트…. 잠깐 다른 생각이 떠올라서요. 미안해요. 하여튼 미뉴에: Oh, Minuet... Sorry, I was thinking about something else. Anyway, you're right. I'm here for Iris.
Yes, Adventurer. Then I think it's time for me to sleep.
What? Oh... All right. I'll be going, then.
strings.(아드리카에서 인기척이 사라지자 미뉴에트가 조용히 커다란 바위 옆에 몸을: (Once the adventurer's presence has left Adrica, Minuet quietly leans against a large rock. She closes her eyes and tries to sleep, as though longing for a dream.)
strings.(그러나 아주 잠시 뿐, 이내 다시 눈을 뜨고 만다.): (But only for a moment. Soon, her eyes open again.)
strings.이제 잠을 잘 수 있는 날이 얼마나 남았지…?: How many more days will I still be able to sleep...?
